title: The exploding learning rate
description: `fit_slope` fits y = w x with gradient descent but returns `inf` or `nan`. The maths of the gradient is correct. What is wrong?
explanation: For MSE on this data the curvature is 2 * mean(x^2) = 28, so gradient descent is stable only for lr < 2/28 = 0.071. With lr = 0.5 every step overshoots further. Lower the learning rate.
